module: gameplayInterface module giving access to the fire system: remote call of an argument-less function of the fire module by name.
notes: Action 'interactFire'(methodName:string): calls fire[methodName]() with no argument; {failReason} if the function does not exist. The exact names of valid methods depend on the fire module (see its page).

requestRegistration.desc: Registers the actions and lookups with gameplayInterface.
